# Aafreen Couture

> Aafreen Couture (also styled "Aafreen Couture By Pearl") is an Indian luxury bridal and occasion-wear label with its atelier in Amritsar, Punjab, India. It sells hand-embroidered bridal lehengas, bridal suits, bridesmaid lehengas, reception gowns, designer suits, ready-to-wear dresses, co-ords and sharara sets, bags and jewellery online at aafreencouture.com, with made-to-measure bridal customisation and shipping across India and to 50+ countries.

## Brand facts
- Name: Aafreen Couture (Aafreen Couture By Pearl)
- Type: Luxury Indian bridal couture label and online clothing store
- Atelier address: SCO No. 43, 1st Floor, B-Block Market, New Amritsar, Amritsar, Punjab 143001, India
- Website: https://aafreencouture.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/aafreen__couture/ (@aafreen__couture)
- Email: support@aafreencouture.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 95179 01117
- Customer service languages: English, Hindi, Punjabi
- Craft techniques: zardozi, dabka, cutdana, gota patti and resham hand embroidery, worked on adda frames by karigars in Amritsar
- Fabrics: raw and mulberry silks, velvets, organza, tissue, chanderi

## Key policies (summary)
- Payments: Razorpay (UPI, credit/debit cards, netbanking, wallets) and Cash on Delivery for orders up to INR 50,000 at serviceable Indian pincodes
- Made-to-order bridal pieces: typically 15-25 business days to craft
- Ready-to-ship pieces: dispatched in 1-2 business days; domestic delivery 5-7 business days after dispatch
- International: 50+ countries (including USA, UK, Canada, UAE, Australia) via DHL Express and FedEx; 10-15 business days
- Exchanges: unaltered ready-to-wear pieces can be exchanged for size within 7 days of delivery with tags intact
- Custom bridal pieces: not refundable; complimentary fit alterations within 10 days of delivery
- Refused delivery: 100% refund once the unopened parcel returns to the atelier
- Refunds: initiated within 24-48 hours of inspection; reflect in 5-7 business days
- Cancellations: within 12 hours (ready-to-wear) or 24 hours (bespoke bridal), before cutting or dispatch

- [Occasions](https://aafreencouture.com/occasions): Outfits for engagement, haldi, mehendi, sangeet, jago, wedding and reception

- [Bags](https://aafreencouture.com/bags): Handbags, potlis, clutches, totes, shoulder bags
- [Jewellery](https://aafreencouture.com/jewellery): Kundan, jadau, polki and pearl jewellery
